notes.title: Royal Rescue Update 0.5 Major bug fixes
notes.content:
[i][u][b]Major Update date: May 28, 2020[/b][/u][/i]

[b][h1]Bug Fixes[/h1][/b]
[list]
[*] The problem with the additional start character has been resolved. Playing now from the beginning Dreak will not be added to the team.
[*] Helena will not join during the final map.
[*] Quest 3 is now revealed after completing chapter 4.
[*] Quest 8 no longer causes the game to end.
[*] Several characters who didn't have correct weapons were repaired.
[*] The spawn has been repaired on the Smithsforte Fields map.
[*] Other Small bug fixes.
[/list]


Royal Rescue is available on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217860/Royal_Rescue_SRPG/

For more information, and press inquiries, please contact blacerlimited@gmail.com

Thank you for your support thank all for your feedback! 
Love you !

Blacer Studio

notes.title: Royal Rescue Release - Date 23 May 1:00 AM GMT+1 Time
notes.content:
[h3]We are ready to annouce that The World Premiere of [i]Royal Rescue SRPG[/i] will take place [u][b]23 May 1:00 AM GMT+1 Time[/b][/u][/h3]

[h2][i]POLAND, MAY 21 2020. [/i][/h2]

Blacer Studio, a micro-studio has today revealed Premiere date of Royal Rescue: a role-playing game with a turn-based combat system. 

Premiere date: 23 May 1:00 AM GMT+1 Time

Watch the reveal trailer here. 
[previewyoutube=cXl-BYiZFbs;leftthumb][/previewyoutube]
The "Royal Rescue" game tells the story where a princess is kidnapped and must be saved by a brave knight, which is you! Your task is to gather the team and save her!

The game is brought to life by Nikodem Świder this is his first SPRG game that he made ever. Most of the elements were created by one person. Also the game would not have been possible without the SRPG Studio and their community.


Royal Rescue is available to wishlist on Steam, with the release this month!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1217860/Royal_Rescue_SRPG/

For more information, and press inquiries, please contact blacerlimited@gmail.com
